title: Want You Bad
lyrics:
[00:14.16]If you could only read my mind
[00:16.62]You would know that things between us ain't right
[00:23.25]I know your arms are open wide
[00:25.54]But you're a little on the straight side, I can't lie
[00:32.53]Your one vice
[00:34.59]Is you're too nice
[00:37.08]Come around now, can't you see?
[00:41.70]I want you all tattooed
[00:46.24]I want you bad
[00:50.76]Complete me, mistreat me
[00:55.03]I want you to be bad, bad, bad, bad, bad
[01:04.22]If you could only read my mind
[01:06.61]You would know that I've been waiting so long
[01:13.32]For someone almost just like you
[01:15.72]But with attitude, I'm waiting, so come on
[01:22.25]Get out of Clothestime
[01:24.56]Grow out those highlights
[01:27.08]Come around now, can't you see?
[01:31.67]I want you in a vinyl suit
[01:36.25]I want you bad
[01:40.73]Complicated, X-rated
[01:45.34]I want you bad, bad, bad, bad, bad, bad
[02:03.47]Don't get me wrong
[02:06.06]I know you're only being good
[02:12.60]But that's what's wrong
[02:15.16]I guess I just misunderstood, go!
[02:37.64]I want you all tattooed
[02:42.18]I want you bad
[02:46.70]Complicated, X-rated
[02:51.30]I want you bad
[02:55.82]I mean it, I need it
[03:00.36]I want you bad, bad, bad, bad, bad
[03:08.86]Bad, really, really bad
